name: connected-accounts
title: Connected accounts
description: The sign-in providers linked to an account: who is connected, as whom and since when, with connect and disconnect per row and a guard on the last way in.
docs: An account counts as connected once it has an identity or a connection date. Without canDisconnect, the only connected provider is protected; pass your own rule when a password or passkey also counts as a way in. protectedHint says how to add another way in: a tooltip on the protected provider, and plain text under the row on touch screens and in narrow rows where a tooltip cannot open. Dates are shown in the timeZone you pass (default UTC) so server and browser agree.
